王建新最近是过得最潇洒舒服的时候。

不用再像之前那样天天绷着弦，也不用惦记着去哪儿搞物资了。乌兰巴托那一趟搬回来的东西，够他用好几辈子的。现在他每天的生活就是——在空间里修炼一会儿，玩一会儿，陪他的小狗子玩一会儿。

那五条小狗崽，在空间里养了两个多月，已经长大了不少。

空间里吃得好，每天能喝牛奶、吃肉，一个个长得肉墩墩的，毛色发亮，圆滚滚的跟小肉球似的。五条狗挤在一起打闹的时候，滚来滚去的，看着就喜庆。王建新给它们起了名字，按大小个排，大毛、二毛、三毛、四毛、五毛。五毛最小，但最皮，整天追着哥哥姐姐咬。

最近他又杀了两次羊。

空间里的羊，跟外面的不一样。在空间里养了这么久，吃的全是空间里种的牧草，喝的是空间里的河水，一个个膘肥体壮，毛色白亮。王建新杀了一只，炖了一锅手把肉，吃到嘴里的时候就觉出来了——这羊肉不对劲。

怎么个不对劲法呢？就是吃完了以后，浑身暖洋洋的，从胃里往外暖，跟喝了热酒似的。而且肉的口感特别好，嫩、滑、香，还有一种说不出来的清甜。

“有淡淡的灵气。”王建新闭上眼睛感受了一下，确实，肉里带着灵气，虽然很淡，但确实存在。

这要是给普通人吃，绝对能改善体质。常年吃这种肉，身体肯定比一般人强得多。王建新心里美得很，以后回城了，给家里人带点这种羊肉，爹妈吃了身体好，小妹吃了长得壮。

他还是隔个三五天出去巡一次边。

大雪虽然还没下，但天已经很冷了。每次巡边的时候，他骑着马，后面跟着五条狗，一路倒也热闹。五条狗在草原上撒欢，跑来跑去的，一会儿追兔子，一会儿互相咬，叫叫嚷嚷的，把寂静的草原闹得鸡飞狗跳。

铁丝网现在又恢复到老样子，安安静静的，没人没动静。自从乌兰巴托那档子事以后，对面的巡逻加强了几天，后来又慢慢松懈了，现在又跟以前一样，连个人影都看不见。

巡边回来以后，王建新进入空间开始做饭。

现在的好吃的太多了。米面粮油堆成山，调料齐全得很，肉有羊肉牛肉，菜有白菜萝卜土豆，水果有苹果橘子，零食有巧克力饼干糖果，想吃什么有什么。

变着花样做，今天红烧羊肉，明天葱爆牛肉，后天烤羊排，大后天西红柿牛腩。主食换着吃，今天米饭，明天面条，后天烙饼，大后天蛋炒饭。

吃着吃着，王建新发现自己开始挑食了。

这个不想吃，那个不爱吃了。红烧羊肉吃腻了，想换个口味；米饭吃多了，想喝点粥。

“这人啊，真的不能吃得太饱。”王建新端着碗，看着一桌子菜，叹了口气。以前在苏和家的时候，一碗奶茶一块奶干就顶一顿饭，饿得前胸贴后背。现在倒好，山珍海味摆在面前，还嫌没胃口。

但叹归叹，饭还是得吃。他扒拉了两口米饭，夹了几筷子菜，凑合着填饱了肚子。

吃饱了，王建新开始干正事。

空间里的地还空着一大片，十来亩地，种了牧草和蔬菜的只有一小半，大部分还是光秃秃的。以前他懒得种，觉得有吃有喝就行了。但现在闲着也是闲着，而且有了拖拉机，种地也不费劲。

他把拖拉机从车场开出来，挂上播种机。播种机是苏联货，谷物条播机，能播小麦、大麦、牧草种子。

王建新从物资堆里翻出牧草种子——他把种子倒进播种机的种箱里，按照操作流程调整好播种量，然后发动拖拉机，开始干活。

拖拉机突突突地响着，拉着播种机在地里走。播种机后面开出一行行整齐的沟，种子均匀地撒进去，后面的镇压轮再把土压实。一垄一垄的，又快又齐整。

“这机器就是好。”王建新坐在拖拉机上，扶着方向盘，看着身后一大片播完种的土地，心里美得很。

几亩地的牧草种子，不到半天就播完了。搁以前得好几天。

播完了，他又接上水泵，从河里抽水浇地。河水顺着管子喷出来，均匀地洒在刚播完种的土地上。水渗进黑土里，种子喝饱了水，用不了几天就能发芽。

牧草播完了，对面还剩块空地。王建新又换了小麦种子，把剩下的地全部种上了小麦。不多，也就一两亩，但收成好的话，也能打不少粮食。

种完了地，王建新又开始搞基建。

他在空间里转了一圈，发现河两岸虽然分开了，但来回不方便。每次要去对面，要么跳过去，要么出了空间再进来。跳过去倒是容易，三四米宽的河，他炼气二层轻轻一跃就过去了。但五个毛过不去。

“得修座桥。”王建新想了想，说干就干。

他从建材堆里翻出木板、木方、钢管，在河面最窄的地方搭了一座小木桥。桥不宽，一米多点，够一个人走。桥面铺了木板，两边有栏杆，走在上面稳稳当当的。

但王建新在桥头安了一个门。

一个木门，带门栓的。平时门关着，这样牛羊就过不来了。他怕这些牛羊跑到种植区那边去，把菜地和庄稼糟蹋了。河是天然的屏障，但有了桥，屏障就破了，得用门挡着。

他自己和五个毛走的时候，打开门，过去，再关上门。虽然麻烦点，但安全。

桥修好了，王建新又修了一条小路。从火车门口出发，沿着河边，一直通到桥头，再从桥那头延伸到种植区的边缘。小路用碎石子铺的，踩上去沙沙响。石子是从哪儿来的？建材堆里有石子，铺路正好。

Wang Jianxin has been living the most relaxed and comfortable life recently.

There is no need to stretch the string every day like before, and there is no need to worry about where to get supplies.The things he brought back from his trip to Ulaanbaatar were enough to last him a lifetime.Now his daily life is to practice in space for a while, play for a while, and play with his little dog.

Those five puppies have grown up a lot after being raised in the space for more than two months.

They were well fed in the space, and could drink milk and eat meat every day. They were all fat and meaty, with shiny coats, and they were as round as small meat balls.When five dogs huddle together and play, rolling around, it looks festive.Wang Jianxin gave them names, arranged according to size, big hair, two hairs, three hairs, four hairs, five hairs.Wumao is the smallest, but the skinniest. He chases and bites his brothers and sisters all day long.

Recently he killed two more sheep.

The sheep in space are different from those outside.After being raised in space for so long, all they eat is the grass grown in the space, and all they drink is the river water in the space. All of them are fat and strong, and their coats are white and shiny.Wang Jianxin killed one and stewed a pot of mutton. When he ate it, he felt that something was wrong with the mutton.

What's wrong with this method?After eating, I felt warm all over my body, from my stomach to the outside, as if I had drunk hot wine.Moreover, the meat tastes particularly good, tender, smooth, fragrant, and has an indescribable sweetness.

"There is a faint aura." Wang Jianxin closed his eyes and felt it. Indeed, there was aura in the flesh. Although it was very weak, it did exist.

If this was given to ordinary people, it would definitely improve their physique.If you eat this kind of meat all year round, your body will definitely be much stronger than the average person.Wang Jianxin felt very happy. When he returned to the city, he would bring some mutton to his family. His parents would be healthy after eating it, and his little sister would grow strong after eating it.

He still goes out to patrol the border every three to five days.

Although it hasn't snowed heavily yet, it's already very cold.Every time he patrolled the border, he rode a horse, followed by five dogs, and the journey was always lively.Five dogs were having fun on the grassland, running around, chasing rabbits, biting each other, and making a lot of noise in the quiet grassland.

The barbed wire fence is now back to its old state, quiet and no one is moving.Since the incident in Ulaanbaatar, the patrols on the opposite side have been intensified for a few days, and then gradually relaxed. Now it is the same as before, not even a single person can be seen.

After returning from patrol, Wang Jianxin entered the space and started cooking.

There are so many delicious things nowadays.There are mountains of rice, flour, grains and oils, and all the seasonings. The meats include mutton and beef, the vegetables include cabbage, radish and potatoes, the fruits include apples and oranges, and the snacks include chocolate biscuits and candies. You can have whatever you want.

Make it in different ways, braised lamb in braise today, beef stir-fried with green onions tomorrow, grilled lamb chops the day after tomorrow, beef brisket with tomatoes the day after tomorrow.The staple food is changed, rice today, noodles tomorrow, pancakes the day after tomorrow, and egg fried rice the day after tomorrow.

As he ate, Wang Jianxin found that he was becoming picky about food.

This one doesn't want to eat it, and that one doesn't like it.I'm tired of braised lamb and want to change my taste; I've eaten too much rice and want some porridge.

"This man really can't eat too much." Wang Jianxin held the bowl, looked at the table of dishes, and sighed.When I was at Su He's house, a bowl of milk tea and a piece of dry milk was enough for a meal, and I was so hungry that my chest pressed against my back.It's a good time now, with delicacies from the mountains and seas in front of me, but I still have no appetite.

But I sigh, I still have to eat.He took two mouthfuls of rice and picked up a few chopsticks to fill his stomach.

After eating, Wang Jianxin got down to business.

There is still a large area of ​​empty land in the space, about ten acres of land, only a small half of which is planted with grass and vegetables, and most of it is still bare.In the past, he was too lazy to plant crops and thought it would be enough if he had enough to eat and drink.But now I am idle, and with tractors, farming is easy.

He pulled the tractor out of the yard and hooked up the planter.The seeder is a Soviet product, a grain drill that can sow wheat, barley, and pasture seeds.

Wang Jianxin dug out forage seeds from the pile of supplies - he poured the seeds into the seed box of the seeder, adjusted the seeding rate according to the operating procedures, then started the tractor and started working.

The tractor chugs, pulling the planter across the field.Neat rows of trenches are opened behind the seeder, and the seeds are spread evenly, and the compaction wheel at the back compacts the soil.Ridge after ridge, quickly and neatly.

"This machine is so good." Wang Jianxin sat on the tractor, holding on to the steering wheel, looking at the large sown land behind him, feeling very beautiful in his heart.

Several acres of grass seeds were sown in less than half a day.It will take several days to put it aside.

After sowing, he connected the water pump and pumped water from the river to irrigate the ground.The river water sprays out from the pipe and evenly sprinkles the newly sown land.Water seeps into the black soil, and when the seeds are full of water, they will germinate in just a few days.

The pasture has been sown, and there is still an open space on the opposite side.Wang Jianxin changed wheat seeds again and planted all the remaining land with wheat.It's not much, just one or two acres, but if the harvest is good, you can get a lot of grain.

After planting the land, Wang Jianxin started working on infrastructure again.

He turned around in the space and found that although the two banks of the river were separated, it was inconvenient to go back and forth.Every time you want to go to the opposite side, you must either jump over or leave the space and come in again.It was easy to jump across. The river was three to four meters wide, and he could cross it with a single jump on the second level of Qi Refining.But five cents is too much to pass.

"We have to build a bridge." Wang Jianxin thought about it and did it.

He dug out planks, wooden squares, and steel pipes from the pile of building materials, and built a small wooden bridge at the narrowest part of the river.The bridge is not wide, just over one meter, enough for one person to walk on.The bridge deck is paved with wooden planks and there are railings on both sides, making it safe to walk on.

But Wang Jianxin installed a gate at the end of the bridge.

A wooden door with a deadbolt.The door is usually closed, so the cattle and sheep cannot get through.He was afraid that the cattle and sheep would run to the planting area and destroy the vegetable fields and crops.The river is a natural barrier, but with a bridge, the barrier is broken and has to be blocked with doors.

When he and Wu Mao left, he opened the door, walked over, and closed the door again.A little troublesome, but safe.

After the bridge was repaired, Wang Jianxin built another path.Starting from the train entrance, along the river, it leads to the bridge, and then extends from the bridge to the edge of the planting area.The path is paved with gravel, which makes a rustling sound when you step on it.Where did the stones come from?There are stones in the building materials pile, which is perfect for paving the road.
